ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominance occupying approximately 95 percent of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels limited to the peripheral trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, contiguous high-intensity white region spans both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped as a narrow, jagged border along the trailing edge and dense clusters at the extreme lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex and symmetrical depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations with irregular peak-to-peak spacing along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A convex mathematical curve characterizes the sweep of the trailing edge from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral points of the fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the distal margin of the left lobe tip, distinct from the uniform serration pattern of the trailing edge.
